about_short_description.short_description: Roe AI is an AI-native data platform for unstructured data stored in blob storage and CRMs.

product.name: Agentic Risk Data Platform
product.description: A platform that uses AI agents to automate risk and compliance workflows by analyzing unstructured data from various sources such as websites, documents, and social media.

product.name: ROE AI SQL-Based Data Infrastructure
product.description: A SQL-driven data infrastructure that enables high-throughput processing and querying of unstructured data using AI agents, compatible with common data pipelines.

product.name: Multimodal SQL Engine
product.description: An engine that supports querying and manipulating multimodal data types such as text, images, videos, and PDFs using SQL combined with AI agents.

product.name: Custom Risk Policy AI Agents
product.description: AI agents configured to apply internal risk policies for bespoke classification and compliance checks on unstructured data.

product.name: Scam Risk AI Agents
product.description: AI agents that analyze merchant websites and digital presence to predict the likelihood of exit scams or fraudulent behavior.

product.name: Regulatory Rule Collection AI Agents
product.description: AI agents that extract and collect regulatory compliance rules from government and regulatory documents for automated compliance monitoring.
